subject: Discovery alignment & pilot kickoff readiness — Galileo Systems
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Khan <emma.khan@galileosystems.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@galileosystems.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & proposed pilot approach

Hi Emma / Olivia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed minimal pilot we discussed so we’re aligned before we loop in procurement/infra: 

Pain points we heard
- High false positives on classification rules for support tickets (esp. billing, contract questions).
- Slow turnaround for vendor redaction and PII detection in incoming docs.
- Current throughput limits force them to batch overnight — want near-real-time quality at ~200 qps.

Goals for pilot (mutual)
- Demonstrate 30% reduction in false positives on the ticket classifier on a 30k sample set.
- Achieve sub-250ms median gen latency for the candidate model configuration during steady-state.
- Validate end-to-end integration with Galileo’s ticket pipeline and a small redaction flow.

Proposed pilot (3–5 week minimal engagement) — scope summary
- Week 0: Access & environment setup (sample S3, service account, test dataset + schema).
- Week 1–2: Prompt set and evals (we’ll run prompt sweeps, provide prompt_matrix_v0.3.csv).
- Week 3: Performance/load pass and ops handoff (observability hooks + KV cache tuning).
- Deliverables: pilot_runbook_v1.pdf, evaluation report, and MA plan spreadsheet.

Owners & roles (initial)
- Galileo: Olivia Park (product lead), Mark Li (infra lead).
- Redwood: Aditya Rao (AM, point of contact), Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng — technical lead), Grace O'Connor (Customer Success).

Immediate asks from Galileo
1) Provide a stripped sample dataset (30k records) and schema or an s3 path we can ingest.
2) Confirm a 2-hour maintenance window (preferred Wed 10–12 PT) for any infra/deployment changes.
3) Procurement contact + PO cadence so we can surface a short MA/contract.

Attachments included: GALILEO_MAPlan_v1.xlsx, prompt_matrix_v0.3.csv (prompt examples + eval buckets).

If that reads right I’ll draft a lightweight mutual action plan (SOW-style) and a kickoff invite for next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Emma Khan <emma.khan@galileosystems.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@galileosystems.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T12:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & proposed pilot approach

Aditya —

Appreciate the clear summary. This looks like a good minimal test for us. A few quick notes from our side:

- Confirmed: Olivia will drive product acceptance and Mark Li will own infra/credentials. I’ve looped both above.
- Procurement: send the MA plan and we’ll route to our procurement team (expect a 7–10 business day review).
- Security: please share SOC 2 + SSO details. We’ll need those to enable a short-term sandbox.
- Timeline: 4–5 weeks works; we’d prefer the pilot to conclude before our quarter close (target Dec 20).

On the dataset: I can create a tokenized sample S3 path with 30k records by EOD tomorrow. We’ll also share a contact for our infra VPN if required.

I’ll book a 30-minute kickoff for Tue 11/16 at 10:00 PT if that works — tentative for now until we get your runbook.

Thanks —
Emma Khan
Director of Product | Galileo Systems
emma.khan@galileosystems.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Khan <emma.khan@galileosystems.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff plan — owners, timeline, access

Emma / team —

Following Aditya’s recap (below) and Emma’s note — I’m attaching a compact pilot_runbook_v1.pdf that lays out the technical checklist and walk-through. Key bits here so we can move quickly tomorrow: 

Pilot technical checklist (what we need from Galileo)
- S3 sample: read-only IAM role for redwood-pilot@galileo (or pre-signed s3 URI).
- Service account: a short-lived service account for API calls + one inbox of real tickets for eval.
- Network: if you prefer non-public egress we can use an SFTP drop or temporary VPN; otherwise we’ll use mTLS endpoints.

Success metrics & eval approach
- Accuracy: baseline classifier FPR and FNR against your annotated 30k set — target: 30% reduction in FPR.
- Latency: median gen latency < 250ms at 50–200 qps during a 10m sustained window.
- Regression controls: baseline prompt set + holdout for manual review (prompt_matrix_v0.3.csv).

Schedule (draft)
- Tue 11/16 (kickoff): confirm contacts + access.
- Wed 11/17–Fri 11/26: prompt sweeps and model tuning (daily sync 20m).
- Mon 11/29–Fri 12/3: load run & ops tuning; build final eval report.

Redwood owners: Aditya (AM), Karthik (Solutions Eng lead), Grace (CS lead). We’ll post access notes and runbook into the Drive link Aditya mentioned and also attach the runbook to the kickoff calendar.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3galileo-pilot 
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321

Let me know if VPN is required — we can scope that in parallel.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Emma / team —

Confirmed — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve: 
- Uploaded pilot_runbook_v1.pdf and GALILEO_MAPlan_v1.xlsx to the Drive folder (link below).
- Sent the MA plan to procurement (expected 7–10bd review).
- Added a tentative calendar for Tue 11/16 10:00 PT (please accept or propose new time).

DocuSign (MA): https://app.docusign.com/MA/RDW-2026-GAL-472
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3galileo-pilot

Next steps checklist (short):
- Emma / Mark: share S3 read-only path or IAM role + sample schema (EOD 11/15 would be ideal).
- Galileo procurement: review MA plan and confirm procurement contact.
- Redwood: Karthik to post runbook and start prompt sweeps once S3 access is available.

If any night/weekend window is required for infra touches we’ll coordinate with Mark directly. Looking forward to the kickoff and a short pilot that shows value fast.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
